fact_text: Ucaaz runs a franchise-based chain of neighbourhood grocery mini-marts in Pakistan, supported by its own end-to-end retail software and ERP.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Ucaaz said it had 70-plus stores by the interview date, in Karachi, Hyderabad, Rawalpindi, Islamabad and Sawabi.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management said franchisees need no prior retail or grocery experience; after one week of training and store setup, a mart can open within 15 days of signing the agreement.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management said Ucaaz funds 100% of store inventory and holds a security deposit from the franchisee that it described as 60% of the investment.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Profit is shared 60% to the mart owner and 40% to Ucaaz as franchisor, according to management.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management said the franchisee's job is mainly selling; Ucaaz's software and team handle purchasing, reorders and supplier management, so the owner does not have to fund ongoing stock purchases.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Ucaaz's software reorders stock using supplier minimum order quantities and a seasonal, AI-based demand model, ordering more in peak seasons and less off-season, and it learns demand by area and SKU.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Ucaaz's point-of-sale software keeps running for up to a week without internet at a store and syncs to the cloud when connectivity returns; management said foreign proprietary systems lack this.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management said every Ucaaz store issues FBR-integrated POS invoices and all its suppliers are GST-registered, which it described as unique among neighbourhood stores in Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management said Ucaaz's 100% supply comes from GST-registered genuine suppliers, including direct FMCG supply, and that it does not sell fake or low-grade products.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management said its prices are below what neighbourhood shoppers pay after travelling to wholesale markets, because the chain buys in bulk directly from FMCG companies.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management said stores can be ordered from online, by phone, through WhatsApp or in person, and it guarantees the best prices in the neighbourhood.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management said it runs background checks, signs a formal agreement and takes a minimum security deposit from each franchisee before opening; the owner stays responsible for inventory even with store cameras.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Ucaaz runs an express store format and a mini store format; management said it has merged some mini stores into larger stores as a strategy, as of the interview date.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management said it had 500-plus registered leads from people wanting to join the chain as franchisees, at a time when many had lost money in property.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management said Ucaaz took no bank loans or venture capital; it was funded by private investors, including a UAE-based group and a US-based group.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management said an early obstacle was sourcing: many neighbourhood suppliers were not GST-registered, which made it hard to buy oil and other goods from compliant vendors.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management said FBR compliance has become more systematic, easing the GST sourcing problem, though it said room for improvement remains as of the interview date.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management named law and order problems as a major local challenge for its stores.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management said Ucaaz is surviving on its own funds while most startups it began alongside have closed, and that its early plan to scale faster than local conditions allowed was revised.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management said its early ambition was 1,000-plus stores within about a year and lakhs of employees within two years, targets it said local conditions made harder to reach.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management said its model could reach 10,000 marts in Pakistan, which it called not impossible, citing Indonesia's Indomaret chain as a comparison.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Ramadan brings a sharp spike in grocery demand, including bulk ration-bag orders from NGOs, so retail turnover is lumpy around the season on top of a steady average run-rate.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management said the shift of monthly grocery buying to large chain marts has pushed many small neighbourhood grocery stores, some run for 30-40 years, to close.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management said distributors and manufacturers in Pakistan often lack systems to manage their own supply chains, which leads to frequent local stock shortages.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Management said about 90% of the startups that began alongside it in AI, supply chain, retail and wholesale have closed, as international funding stopped flowing to Pakistan amid the dollar crisis.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Building a Retail Empire: How UCAAZ Took on Giants | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)
